{{Quote|The Jedi shuttle taking him back to the Temple got caught in an emergency checkpoint. The sister of one of my senate staffers is a security officer. She flew escort for them once the problem was resolved.|Bail Organa to Padmé Amidala discussing Obi-Wan Kenobi's condition|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], she was part of an emergency checkpoint set up in the aftermath. There, she stopped the [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] containing [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was wounded during the attack. Seeing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the officer escorted the speeder back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] so that Kenobi could receive emergency treatment. The officer later told her [[Unidentified Organa staffer|sister]], a staffer for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], about the wounded Kenobi, and the sister in turn told Senator Organa.<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', which was written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
